applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Identify the incoming payment as a tax-authority refund and retain the authority's refund evidence. Submit that evidence against the actual held payment using the tax-refund category where available.

If the Portal does not offer an appropriate category, contact support to arrange submission. Do not describe the refund as an unrelated marketplace sale merely to access a different form.

The payment remains subject to the incoming review process. Uploading the refund evidence does not itself establish that the amount has been credited.
